facebook.caption:
This place resets your brain.

Dinh Cậu Lighthouse sits at the edge of Dương Đông, where the river meets the sea. Watch fishing boats drift past at golden hour. No crowds pushing for the same photo. Just wind, water, and a view that actually makes you stop.

If Phu Quoc has been feeling too loud, come here first.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
